scope: fresh real generation and workflow integration; descriptive small-case study

checkpoint.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU, 6141 MiB

generation_entry: Direct CLI versus scripted ProductionService methods; neither generation arm used an LLM. A separate current Harness demo uses real DeepSeek for read-only shortlist recommendation.

fairness.seed_note: Installed pinned MatterGen CLI does not expose --seed; current upstream may differ. No paired-sample generation superiority claim.

process_comparison.direct: User selects checkpoint and writes CLI options and property dictionary
process_comparison.plugin: User expresses intent; agent queries capabilities and produces structured plan with unsupported requirements exposed

process_comparison.direct: User chooses output directory and launches/checks command
process_comparison.plugin: Approved plan ID, idempotency key, job state and bounded sample budget

process_comparison.direct: Extract and inspect CIFs; script or official evaluation needed for checks
process_comparison.plugin: Collect records with SHA256, stable IDs, parse/requirement checks and report

process_comparison.direct: User implements selection rules or uses other tools; strong baselines use identical prechecks here
process_comparison.plugin: One recommend_candidates tool applies fixed eligibility, deduplication and categorical coverage with reasons

boundaries: Workflow integration and categorical shortlist coverage are tested; no energy, stability, synthesizability, catalysis, corrosion or device-performance conclusion.
No material relaxation or DFT was performed.
No timing speedup or causal scientific-quality claim from unpaired random generation.
Generic Harness can also invoke scripts; integration advantage is reusable capability-aware tools and audit trail, not exclusive access to these algorithms.
